MAJOR UPDATE [Sept. 22nd, 2026]:

Myself and the Manga-Kun for "My Chubby Girlfriend/My Chubby Wife" (Poochari wa Sekai wo Sukuu [Poocha]) are working together on an OFFICIAL English translation of "My Chubby Girlfriend." I am extremely proud and honored to be working directly with the artist of the manga! It's a dream come true!

This means future chapters will be posted on Poocha's official Pixiv and X. A new e-hentai gallery will also be created later on once more chapters release. Expect updates in the near future.

Poocha's X Profile - https://x.com/pooooocha10
Poocha's Pixiv Profile - https://www.pixiv.net/en/users/89686730

Due to this, I will no longer be working on the unofficial translation. I understand this may be disappointing to those who read this version and have been patiently waiting for updates, but the official translation will stay true to the Manga-Kun's creative intent and will be the best way to read the manga. It may take some time to catch up, but I promise it will be worth the wait, and may be a great opportunity to re-read your favorite moments officially!

Poocha has also requested most of the unofficial chapters be taken down to avoid confusion. Out of respect for his work, I've taken down the previous chapters on this archive, ending at Chapter 20 upon his request.

I want to thank Cretino for helping inspire my unofficial translation effort for My Chubby Girlfriend / My Chubby Wife and all the work he's done to share Poocha's manga with the Spanish-speaking community. I also want to thank you all for the amazing feedback on the unofficial translation. What started as a personal passion project is now official, and it's all thanks to you.

I can't wait to share more soon!

Thanks So Much,
- BiggerBuddy.

----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

This is a re-write of the Spanish translation of this comic. Since the original comic hasn't been updated for some time I've taken the project on for the past few weeks. Hope you enjoy!

Special Thanks to Cretino for the original Spanish translation & Idefirka for uploading the original English translation.

Update 04/23/26 - Just got back from a month-long work trip, so I'm still a bit behind on chapters. I'll be working on updating the archive over the next week or so. Posting what's been completed so far!

Update 08/19/26 - First batch of pages are OUT! Pages 485 - 528 are updated. Will be working on the remaining pages to be caught up to the Spanish translation by hopefully the end of the month. Will continue updating as it comes!
n: [Doujinshi] (Poochari wa Sekai wo Sukuu) My Chubby Girlfriend [UNOFFICIAL English Re-Write]
